# Louie Dela Cruz, GoHighLevel Growth Bundle

> Louie Dela Cruz is a HighLevel Certified Admin and Top Rated Upwork freelancer with 4 years of GoHighLevel experience. Based in the Philippines, he works Irish, UK and Australian business hours and sells a done-for-you growth bundle to small businesses: Facebook and Instagram ads, AI lead scraping, GoHighLevel CRM setup, website design, and landing pages and funnels.

## Services
- Facebook and Instagram Ads: campaign and audience setup, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking, ad copy and creative, weekly optimisation.
- AI Lead Scraping: lead lists by niche and location, cleaned, de-duplicated and imported into GoHighLevel with tags.
- GoHighLevel CRM Setup: CRM, pipelines, calendars, SMS and email follow-up, missed call text back, review requests, AI chat agent.
- Website Design: mobile-first websites with forms, booking and on-page SEO, connected to GoHighLevel.
- Landing Pages and Funnels: offer, lead magnet, booking and opt-in pages with tracking.
- AI Voice, AI Chat and Super Agents: native GoHighLevel Voice AI receptionist, Conversation AI on website, SMS, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and AI agents that qualify, book and update the CRM 24/7.

## Prices (2026)
- Launch: €1,190 / £990 / A$1,990 one-off. Website up to 5 pages, 1 landing page, GoHighLevel CRM, pipeline, calendar, follow-up workflow, 30 days support.
- Growth: €1,490 / £1,290 / A$2,490 setup, then €590 / £490 / A$990 a month. Adds Facebook and Instagram ads management, tracking, 3 more landing pages, nurture workflows.
- All In: €1,990 / £1,690 / A$3,290 setup, then €990 / £850 / A$1,690 a month. Adds AI lead scraping (1,000 leads a month), outreach sequences, AI chat agent, monthly report.
- Ad spend, GoHighLevel subscription and VAT/GST are extra. Monthly plans: 3 month minimum, then month to month.

Laid off from a BPO job during the pandemic, Louie was introduced to GoHighLevel, taught himself, and went on to do onboarding for Extendly, tech support for Krista Mashore Coaching and Tradie Web Guys, and project management for two white-label GoHighLevel SaaS platforms.
